title: Swipe to reply, safer view once
items: Swipe a message to the right to reply, like WhatsApp.
View once media is now protected: it hides when you switch apps or press a screenshot key, cannot be saved or printed, and shows your number as a watermark.

title: Sticker packs, better emoji & GIF search, update card
items: Ready sticker packs for everyone: MHTalk Buddy, Kitty and "Say it" (Salam, Shukriya, InshaAllah, LOL…).
Search stickers by word: love, lol, salam, sad…
Emoji search now finds every emoji (try "cry", "red heart", "pizza").
GIF tab has quick chips: Haha, Love, Sad, Wow, Party and more.
New versions show a small card: Update now or Later. It hides by itself after a few seconds and stays in Settings → App update.
Installed app: share photos, videos, GIFs or stickers from other apps (Share → MHTalk) and pick the chats to send to.

title: Trim videos, GIF & sticker favourites, new status screen
items: Cut a video before sending: drag the white handles at the start or end (chats and status).
Status videos are kept to 60 seconds, like WhatsApp.
New status screen: caption on its own line, then "Status (audience)" and the green send button.
Choose audience opens as a sheet: My contacts, My contacts except…, Only share with…, Everyone.
GIF tab shows "Recent" GIFs from your chats, including ones others sent you.
Long-press a sticker someone sent → "Add to my stickers" to keep it in your Sticker tab.

title: App updates in Settings
items: Settings now shows a green dot when a new version of MHTalk is ready.
Open Settings → App update to read what's new and update when you want.
Your chats, messages and login stay the same after updating.

title: WhatsApp-style message bar
items: Desktop: attach (📎) on the far left, then emoji, the message box, camera and the mic.
Phones: the emoji, GIF and sticker panel opens under the message box in place of the keyboard, with a ⌫ delete key.
Video previews fit the screen before sending.
Send contacts looks like WhatsApp Web, with "You" and "Contacts on MHTalk".

title: Safer start-up
items: If something goes wrong while opening, you see Reload / Reset app instead of a black screen.
After an update, old saved files are refreshed automatically.

title: Long messages and bigger files
items: Very long messages show "Read more".
Press and hold a message: first the reactions, keep holding to select it.
Send photos, videos and documents up to 100 MB.

title: Status privacy and call info
items: "My contacts" status is only shown to people you saved.
Call info lists the calls of the day you tapped.
Share a contact from Contacts or Contact info.
